title: Flydubai cockpit attack: Israel to honour Capt Smit with top civilian bravery award
content: Israel has announced that Captain Smit Machchhar will receive a prestigious Presidential Award for his bravery. He prevented a potential aviation disaster aboard Flydubai flight FZ1073 by acting decisively against a radicalized co-pilot. During the incident, six Israeli passengers displayed great courage in assisting Machchhar and foiling the hijack attempt. This heroic act has led to a broader investigation into the circumstances of the attack.

title: Nana Patekar cremated with full state honours, fans bid tearful farewell
content: The Indian film industry mourns the loss of Nana Patekar, who succumbed to cardiac arrest as confirmed by his son. The actor's passing, attributed to natural causes, prompted the Maharashtra government to orchestrate a state funeral fitting his legacy in cinema. Tributes poured in from fans and fellow actors in Pune, with many sharing their fond memories of the beloved artist on social media.

title: IAF celebrates its 94-year-old glorious journey
content: Indian Air Force celebrated its 94th anniversary at Hindon Air Force Station showcasing its historical significance. The event featured aerobatics by the vintage Tiger Moth and a display of military aircraft. IAF Chief ACM Singh emphasized the importance of operational preparedness and joint operations with the Army and Navy. PM Narendra Modi and Defence Minister Rajnath Singh commended the courage and dedication of IAF personnel.

title: Abhishek Sharma on the cusp of breaking Suryakumar Yadav’s unique T20I record
content: Abhishek Sharma is on the brink of achieving a remarkable milestone, needing just 53 runs to cross 2,000 T20I runs during the second T20I against West Indies. With a chance to eclipse Suryakumar Yadav's record for the fastest attainment of this feat, Sharma's current high strike rate demonstrates his game-changing prowess.

title: GST Council scraps tax officers' arrest powers, eases refund rules
content: The GST Council has proposed major procedural changes to enhance business operations and tax compliance. These reforms aim to streamline registration, refunds, and input tax credit processes while lowering compliance costs. Additionally, the council will remove officers' powers for arrests under the GST framework. Processing of refunds will be expedited, with a goal to resolve claims within three days.

title: US suspends Microsoft from Green Card programme, here is what the company has to say
content: The US has suspended Microsoft from the Permanent Labor Certification Program (PERM), freezing new and pending Green Card applications for its foreign workers. Vice President JD Vance accused Microsoft of abusing the H-1B and PERM system to replace laid-off American workers. Microsoft says 80% of its roughly 6,000 H-1B filings last fiscal year were for existing employees, and that it pays H-1B staff the same as others doing comparable work.

title: ‘Krantiveer’ in life, ‘Natsamrat’ on screen: Nana dies at 75
content: Nana Patekar, a renowned actor from Maharashtra, passed away unexpectedly from a heart attack in Goa. He was known for his powerful performances in both Hindi and Marathi cinema, spanning nearly five decades. Patekar had a notable impact on Indian cinema, often portraying characters that were unpredictable and emotionally complex. He championed various social causes, including rural distress through his NAAM Foundation.

title: Woman claims 2.5 acres was ancestral after stepmother sold it; why HC rejected plea
content: The Madras High Court held that the property was not ancestral but self-acquired. As a result, under Hindu law, the man and his mother were legally entitled to execute the gift settlement deed in favour of the man’s second wife, who could subsequently sell the property.

title: Will those whose earnings have stopped love me: PM Modi amid SIR row
content: PM Narendra Modi called for a global effort to address cyber frauds and deepfakes at the India Mobile Congress. He highlighted the importance of mobile technology as a tool for governance and effective service delivery. Modi attributed significant financial savings to digital direct benefit transfers in India. He urged collaboration among governments and tech companies to enhance security measures in the telecom sector.

title: ‘Reckless’ use of NSA has made it ordinary: MP HC
content: Madhya Pradesh high court quashed the preventive detention of two brothers under the National Security Act. The court criticized the reckless invocation of the Act by authorities and highlighted a lack of evidence. It found the brothers had been acquitted in multiple cases where NSA was applied, asserting non-application of mind. The court underscored the need for constitutional safeguards against arbitrary detentions.

title: Nana Patekar death: Goa Police register 'unnatural death' case
content: Nana Patekar passed away due to a cardiac arrest at his residence in Goa early Thursday morning. He was declared dead after attempts to revive him were unsuccessful at Manipal Hospital. The Goa Police have registered an 'Unnatural Death' case to investigate the circumstances surrounding his death. A post-mortem examination is being conducted to ascertain the exact cause of death.

title: Mark Zuckerberg's sister Arielle leads double life as techno DJ since 2018
content: Mark Zuckerberg’s sister Arielle Zuckerberg has revealed her secret DJ career, saying she has been DJing since 2018. The 37-year-old venture capitalist has played techno sets at clubs, small festivals and Burning Man. She described DJing as a “side quest,” saying she mostly performs with friends for fun and to spread joy.

title: Woman's £80 charity shop Dior bag turns out rare find, sells for £7,870
content: A woman unknowingly found herself in a designer dream when she bought a Dior handbag for just £80 at a Cotswolds charity shop. After authenticating the bag at Kinghams, it was revealed to be a limited-edition Koi Saddle Bag from 2003, ultimately selling for a breathtaking £7,870. This instance illustrates how brilliant bargains can emerge outside of luxury boutiques.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school; 10 years later, Board votes to close it
content: Priscilla Chan's Primary School in California, which aimed to support low-income families, has closed. The school shut down due to funding issues after receiving significant financial support over ten years. It was noted that academic results were mixed, and some features resembled a startup environment. Around 540 children were enrolled prior to the closure, affecting many local families.

title: Bihar teen hits Candy Crush Level 22,222, enters International Book of Records
content: Shubham Kumar, a 19-year-old student from Government Engineering College, Siwan, recently reached Level 22,222 in Candy Crush Saga. His achievement has been recognized by the International Book of Records as the highest level reached by a teenager. After setting the record, he reported reaching further levels in the King Community, demonstrating ongoing dedication to the game. The Bihar government department has congratulated Kumar on his remarkable accomplishment.

title: AI use ups homework scores, but slashes exam marks: Study
content: World Bank's report reveals that unrestricted use of generative AI may enhance homework scores while diminishing actual learning outcomes. Evidence indicates that students using AI showed improvement in assignments but performed worse in exams over time. Concerns exist regarding students outsourcing their learning process to AI rather than engaging in cognitive effort. However, AI used by teachers to customize instruction shows promising learning gains.

title: Donna Kelce’s cookie fundraiser: How did she raise $4,100 for students?
content: Travis Kelce’s mom Donna Kelce helped turn her famous family cookie recipe into a charity fundraiser for Kansas schoolchildren. After small-business owner Annie Stowe received permission to print the recipe on handmade mugs, $5 from each sale went towards paying elementary school lunch debt. The mugs initially raised $2,000 in 2023, followed by another $2,100 after local coverage, bringing the total to $4,100.

title: Connor McDavid’s wife Lauren Kyle: How did she build her five-venture empire?
content: Lauren Kyle McDavid's entrepreneurial journey blossomed with her interior design firm, Kyle & Co. However, she initially struggled with the business side of her creativity. To support her, her husband, Connor McDavid, arranged sessions with a business coach. By June 2025, Lauren broadened her horizons, introducing projects like Sports Club Atelier and Trove Living, all while striving to craft meaningful experiences in her diverse portfolio.

title: KPSC scam candidates taken to resorts, provided with Q&A: ED
content: The Enforcement Directorate reported on a significant corruption case involving the Karnataka Public Service Commission. Candidates for the veterinary officers' exam were allegedly bribed to receive leaked test papers before the exam. An organized syndicate was involved in the manipulation of the recruitment process, leading to multiple arrests of officials. Investigations revealed a systematic approach to generating proceeds of crime through examination material leaks.

title: Bypoll election results: When and where to watch vote counting
content: Votes for five Assembly constituencies and the Nagaon Lok Sabha seat will be counted today. Counting will commence at 8am, with results announced throughout the day. Updates will be provided by the Election Commission of India on their official results website. The Times of India will also provide live coverage of the counting process and results. The counting will occur under security arrangements at the respective counting centres.

title: US sanctions Indian firms, individuals as Iran oil crackdown widens
content: On Thursday, the United States targeted two Mumbai-based companies over their alleged oil trade involvement with Iran. The sanctions affected five Indian nationals connected to SSPL Solutions Private Limited and Samudra Marine Services Private Limited. These measures are part of a broader crackdown on Iran under 'Operation Economic Outcast'. The U.S. government aims to curb Iranian oil revenues fueling military and cyber activities.

title: Group of 42 ex-judges defends SIR, slams opposition attack on Election Commission
content: A group of 42 retired judges has expressed concerns over criticism directed at the Election Commission. They stated these attacks serve vested political interests, compromising democratic integrity. The judges defended the EC's actions as essential to maintaining clean electoral rolls for fair elections. They urged political parties to present legit grievances formally, rather than delegitimizing the electoral process.

title: Jharkhand should 'revisit' DGP appointment rules, says Supreme Court
content: The Supreme Court stated that the appointment process for Jharkhand's DGP likely violated its previous judgment regarding officer tenure. The court issued a notice to Tadasha Singh, appointed shortly before her retirement. The Central Government argued that Jharkhand's amended regulations overstepped the Supreme Court's mandate on DGP appointments. Jharkhand, represented by Kapil Sibal, criticized the selective enforcement of these regulations by the Centre.

title: IPS quota in CAPF posts comes into force
content: The Central Armed Police Forces (General Administration) Act, 2026, has come into effect on October 8. This Act mandates that senior posts in CAPFs be filled by IPS officers on deputation. The government supports this move for better coordination between the Centre and states. CAPF cadre officers express concerns regarding career advancement due to this new quota.

title: Proof of 21 'compromised transfers', 11 policy changes part of CBI's Punjab file
content: CBI has obtained evidence related to compromised transfers involving 21 senior officials in Punjab government and police. The probe focuses on a cash-for-postings scam connected to OSD to Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann. Allegations include various requests for administrative favors and transfer requests surrounding certain officers. The investigation involves interactions with individuals linked to tender manipulations across the state.

title: Starlink entry row: Is Ambani the real boss of India, asks Elon Musk
content: Elon Musk has raised concerns about regulatory obstacles facing Starlink's introduction in India. He claimed influential figures might be hindering the process and questioned if Ambani controls the situation. In response, India's government reaffirmed its fair and non-discriminatory approach, rejecting Musk's allegations. Other companies like Reliance Jio and Eutelsat OneWeb are also vying for approval to offer satellite services.

title: J&K: High court orders passport revival for student purusing MBBS in Iran
content: Ibra Khan, a student pursuing MBBS at Tehran University, had her passport impounded due to her father's past case. The Jammu & Kashmir High Court intervened, recognizing her completion of half the course before the impounding occurred. Legal representatives argued that Khan could not be held accountable for her father's actions from 1997. A division bench ordered the passport's revival while allowing authorities to impose conditions on its use.

title: Cancer drug prices may fall as government plans 30% trade margin cap
content: The Indian government has announced plans to cap trade margins on all types of cancer drugs. This decision aims to make cancer medications more affordable and accessible, potentially reducing prices by up to 70%. It is expected to result in savings of around Rs 2,500 crore annually for patients. An expert committee will be formed to recommend the list of drugs covered by this initiative.

title: Defence secy talks to German envoy & Greece dy min to widen strategic partnerships
content: Newly appointed German Ambassador Jasper Wieck met with Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh to discuss defense cooperation. India and Germany aim to strengthen their military and defense-industrial ties, including advanced technologies. The talk follows high-level engagements and a recent agreement on co-development of defense items. Meanwhile, India engages with Greece on maritime security and coastal protection issues.

title: 'Contest UP polls from Ayodhya': Akhilesh Yadav dares CM Yogi Adityanath
content: Akhilesh Yadav has urged Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath to contest the upcoming assembly elections from Ayodhya. He indicated plans to visit the Ram temple alongside SP leaders after visiting Kedareshwar Dham in Etawah. Yadav also noted that the BJP has been conducting surveys for the Ayodhya seat, claiming they are struggling to find a candidate to challenge him. This statement responds to BJP allegations about his temple visitations.

title: 'Welcome to India': Rahul reacts to Musk's remarks; Starlink boss says 'thank you'
content: Rahul Gandhi has weighed in on Elon Musk's comments about the hold-up of Starlink's commercial operations in India. Musk voiced his exasperation over regulatory obstacles, suggesting that oligarchs sway the industry. The government swiftly countered, emphasising the fairness of its regulations among satellite operators and underlining the importance of security compliance for safeguarding users and data alike.

title: 'Unite to fight': Uddhav Sena to Kejriwal, Stalin; will AAP, DMK relent?
content: Uddhav Thackeray's Shiv Sena has called on AAP and DMK to join opposition forces against CEC Gyanesh Kumar over irregularities in SIR. Despite AAP's separation from the INDIA bloc and DMK's mixed reactions, the lack of participation from both factions underscores existing rifts in the opposition landscape. Analysts argue that these parties might still rally together to uphold democratic principles, though future collaboration remains clouded by their historical rivalries.

title: CJP claims Deepak Baliyan assaulted, brother injured; Rajasthan Police deny action
content: The Cockroach Janata Party reported that their co-incharge, Deepak Baliyan, was detained by Rajasthan Police. This incident occurred ahead of the planned protest in Delhi against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. While party leaders accused police of forceful detention, the police denied such claims. Protests against Kumar have also been held in Bengaluru by various activists and groups.

title: 5 injured after gas cylinder explodes at workers’ shed on IIT Bombay campus
content: A significant incident unfolded on Thursday night when a gas cylinder exploded in a workers' shed at an under-construction building on the IIT Powai campus. Occurring at approximately 10:24 PM in Hostel No. 6, five people sustained injuries—two minors and three adults. Fortunately, all individuals are reported to be in stable condition.

title: Indians among hundreds to get share of $35m payout in labour 'exploitation' case
content: In a significant development, over 100 construction workers are about to be compensated in a settlement linked to Caddell Construction due to allegations of labor exploitation at the new US consulate in Milan. Workers endured illegal wage cutbacks, unpaid overtime, and deplorable working environments. Expected payouts will average near 45,000 euros, with select cases reaching an impressive 90,000 euros.
